author: Timothy Geigner
description: It was just a week or so ago that we were talking about the absurd situation in Knox County, Tennessee, where local government used Tennessee’s book-banning laws to remove the book Roots from school libraries. title: Knox County, TN Rolls Back ‘Roots’ Book Ban After Backlash
